about: SAML 2.0 and SAML 1.1: GET /samlmetadata, POST /samlsign, POST /samlartifactctx, the assertion consumer and Single Logout landings (POST and GET /samlacs, GET /samlacs/artifact, POST and GET /samlslo) and GET /samlresponse. Recorded against the api as it was before the family switched to the model (docs/v0.9.6/data-model.md). The landings are what an IDENTITY PROVIDER's browser reaches, so they are sent as forms (or as query strings) and answer with a 302 whose Location carries a stash id that is new every run, hence volatile. Every outbound target is a .invalid name (RFC 6761). The signing key is a throwaway generated for this file, signs nothing anywhere else, and is here because RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 is deterministic, so a signed redirect is the same bytes on every machine.
